source_evidence: Some investors mistakenly assume that their orders have not been executed and place the order again. They end up buying or selling twice, which can be a costly mistake.
question: Misconception: Once I submit an online order, I can assume it either executed or did not execute without checking its status.
answer: Check whether the order was executed before placing it again. If you repeat an order that already went through, you could buy or sell twice. If you are unsure, ask your financial services firm how to handle it.
